basics.name: Shourav Misro
basics.headline: SQA / QA and IoT / Embedded-focused CSE graduate building reliable software, tested systems, and practical hardware.

about.short: I am a CSE graduate with a blended background in software quality assurance and IoT / embedded systems. I enjoy validating systems, finding practical issues, improving reliability, and working on projects that combine software logic with real-world hardware.
about.long: My work combines structured software testing with practical embedded and IoT development. On the QA side, I focus on manual testing, test case design, API validation, regression testing, and quality bug reporting. On the embedded side, I have experience with ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, communication protocols, sensor integration, actuator control, firmware debugging, and system validation. I enjoy solving practical problems, collaborating in teams, and building systems that are both functional and dependable.

projects.title: LearnLink
projects.summary: QA validation of an ASP.NET MVC learning platform. Executed 50+ test cases, tested 30+ user flows, verified 500+ records, and found 20+ defects.

projects.title: root

projects.title: Hospital Management System
projects.summary: Executed functional and regression tests for patient, appointment, and record modules, identifying issues in validation, workflow logic, and database consistency.

projects.title: Intelligent Solar Panel System
projects.summary: Built an ESP32 and Jetson Nano solar monitoring system with sensor integration, PWM charge control, relay protection, and AI-assisted defect detection.

projects.title: Unified Smart Home Ecosystem

projects.title: Traffic Management System

projects.title: Affordable Prosthetic Hand

projects.title: Personal Dashboard
